# pve_firewall_ipset (Resource)

Firewall IP set at cluster, vm, or container scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_firewall_ipset" "example" {
name = "CHANGE_ME"
scope = "cluster"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) IP set name.
- `scope` (String) One of: `cluster`, `vm`, `container`.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) <string>
- `force` (Boolean) Delete all members of the IPSet, if there are any.
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `rename` (String) Rename an existing IPSet. You can set 'rename' to the same value as 'name' to update the 'comment' of an existing IPSet.
- `vmid` (Number) The (unique) ID of the VM.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: scope/node/vmid/name (also the `terraform import` format).
